fact_text: DG Khan Cement reported Q1 FY26 earnings of PKR 4.93 per share, about 2.7 times the same quarter a year earlier.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's Q1 FY26 net sales rose 18% quarter on quarter to PKR 19.8 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's Q1 FY26 gross margin fell about 10 percentage points quarter on quarter to 22%, against 32% in Q4 FY25 and a FY25 average of 25%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's Q1 FY26 finance cost fell 25% quarter on quarter to PKR 431 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement repaid about PKR 4 billion of loans in Q1 FY26, which cut both its long-term and short-term borrowings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's local cement dispatches rose 8% quarter on quarter in Q1 FY26, and export dispatches rose 2%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's inventory fell from about PKR 9 billion to PKR 4 billion quarter on quarter, which the reporter linked to selling older stock.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter attributed the margin drop mainly to a plant shutdown, when fixed costs rise while the plant is offline, and called it a one-off cost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter expected gross margins to recover toward 25% over the following quarters if demand stays strong.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter estimated EPS of about PKR 6.60 per quarter at a 25% margin, which would bring full-year FY26 earnings to roughly PKR 24-25.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: At the reporter's FY26 earnings estimate of roughly PKR 24-25 per share, the stock traded at close to nine times earnings, which he judged fairly valued.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter said that cement makers' coal costs rose because the Afghanistan border closure lifted local coal prices, even though international coal prices fell.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Cement makers' effective coal cost depends on local coal prices, which can rise through border closures even while international coal prices fall.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter noted cement prices had risen, which could partly offset higher coal costs for cement makers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter put the average replacement cost of a cement plant from Chinese and European suppliers at about USD 65 per ton, against about USD 30 per ton for DG Khan Cement's plant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Replacement cost, the cost of building a new plant of the same capacity, is a valuation benchmark; a stock priced well below it can look attractive to investors, as the reporter argued.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's nine-month 2025 earnings were about PKR 23.99 per share, and third-quarter 2025 earnings per share fell 24% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah announced a third interim dividend of PKR 3.5 per share for 2025 and has paid such a dividend every quarter in recent quarters.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's Q3 2025 net interest income was flat quarter on quarter at PKR 33.1 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah booked a net provisioning charge of PKR 49 million in Q3 2025, against a PKR 1.5 billion reversal in Q2 2025.

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's fee income fell 32% to PKR 4.1 billion in Q3 2025, mainly because remittance fees declined as banks spent more to win remittance market share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah booked gains on securities from its PIB holdings in Q3 2025, which the reporter counted as a positive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's provision reversals over the nine months of 2025 totalled about PKR 2.2 billion, and the reporter said the Q3 charge was small.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's cost-to-income ratio was 61% in Q3 2025, against about 56% for nine months of 2025 and about 50% for the same period in 2024.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter said Bank Alfalah's higher operating expenses were spent to win remittance market share, which raised the cost-to-income ratio as fee income fell.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter said Bank Alfalah's return on equity was about 15% in 2025 and that this level looked sustainable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter estimated full-year 2025 EPS of about PKR 30 if the fourth quarter adds about PKR 7, or roughly PKR 25-27 on a forward basis.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: At the reporter's full-year estimate, Bank Alfalah traded below seven times earnings, a level he judged decent.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's book value was about PKR 150 per share, and the stock traded at about 1.2 times book, which the reporter judged a reasonable level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: Banks are usually valued on price-to-book, so a multiple near 1.2-1.3 times book is compared with the bank's sustainable return on equity to judge value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter expected Bank Alfalah to earn about PKR 6.5 per quarter in Q4 2025 and a similar level in 2026, with its dividend payout maintained at about 50%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)

fact_text: The reporter said earnings could grow from deposit growth, investments and yields, while fee income has room to improve.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Earnings Review of DGKC, BAHL, and MTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-19)
